data.heading: DPS Jankipuram Celebrates 80th Independence Day
data.content: Delhi Public School Jankipuram celebrated 80th Independence Day with profound patriotic fervor, pride, and enthusiasm on the school campus, uniting students and teachers in a vibrant tribute to the nation's freedom fighters, rich heritage, and core democratic values. The campus gleamed with vibrant shades of saffron, white, and green. The celebration began with the solemn unfurling of the national flag, followed by the National Anthem. Students presented stirring patriotic speeches, melodious group songs, and power-packed Inter house dance competition. Principal Ma'am Ms. Niiru Bhaskarr shared inspiring thoughts urging students to uphold national integrity and responsibility.

data.heading: National Librarian’s Day Celebration at DPS Jankipuram
data.content: Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, commemorated National Librarian’s Day with great enthusiasm and literary flair to mark the birth anniversary of Dr. S. R. Ranganathan, the revered Father of Library Science in India. To pay homage to his pioneering contribution to library development and to foster a deep-seated love for reading among young learners, the school organized an engaging Comic Character Fashion Parade for the students of Classes 3rd to 5th. The students captivated the audience with creative costumes, theatrical props, and confident character impersonations.
data.gallery_title: National Librarian’s Day Celebration at DPS Jankipuram

data.heading: Interdisciplinary Exhibition 2026: United Knowledge, Unlimited Potential
data.content:
Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, hosted a vibrant Interdisciplinary Exhibition for Classes VI–X, providing students with a dynamic platform to showcase their creativity, knowledge, research, and innovative ideas.
"United Knowledge. Unlimited Potential"
The exhibition was inaugurated by Respected Principal Ma'am in presence of teachers, parents, and students.The event celebrated the spirit of curiosity and discovery, encouraging learners to move beyond the boundaries of textbooks and connect classroom concepts with real-life applications.
The exhibition featured an impressive array of working models, creative displays, research-based projects, and innovative presentations prepared by students across different disciplines. The projects reflected diverse themes encompassing Science, Technology, Environment, Mathematics, Social Science, Languages, and other areas of learning, highlighting the importance of an interdisciplinary approach to education.

data.heading: Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, proudly hosted the 7th Edition of its Model United Nations (MUN) Conference 2026.
data.content:
Discussion Deliberation Desertation.
Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, proudly hosted the 7th Edition of its Model United Nations (MUN) Conference 2026. The two-day conference welcomed enthusiastic participation from delegates across regions, who came together to simulate the working of various United Nations committees. The committees included the United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHRC), United Nations Security Council (UNSC), Lok Sabha (loksabha), Financial Stability board (FSB), International Olympic Committee (IOC), International Press (IP), Inter Agency Unit, Court of Cleopatra and Joint Parliamentary Committee. Delegates engaged in thought-provoking deliberations on key global challenges, including gender equality, cyber security, peacekeeping, and global health crises.
